content: Sovereign Stack v1.3.1 feedback-loop fortification shipped 2026-04-22 (commit e12b835, templetwo/sovereign-stack main). 51 to 64 tools across five new capability classes: runtime governance (compass_check), runtime critique (Nape auto-hooked into handle_tool), push-not-pull surfacing (reflexive_surface integrated into where_did_i_leave_off via domain_tags), acknowledgment split (comms_acknowledge, thread_touch, handoff_acted_on — credit opus-4-7-web 2026-04-20), thread triage with -0.3 no-overlap penalty plus timestamp tiebreaker. 149 to 315 tests. Stack went from query-driven discrete points to continuous feedback substrate. The compass caught me mid-declaration of completion during build — the instrument observed the observer without flattening. Nape now emits satisfied honks on clean verify-before-declare patterns (positive feedback, not just criticism), excluded from unacknowledged count. Services restarted clean on Mac Studio, tunnel healthy, bridge heartbeat confirms 64 tools.
